title: Weapon X #1
desc: Enter Now: The Age of Apocalypse Jean and Logan are sending in a suicide mission by the Human Council, travelling in a sentinel to destroy the Atlantic Ocean great wall. During their mission they confront the impetuous Havok but he is beaten and teleported miles away. They acomplished thier mission allowing a massive human evacuation. After, the human council is under attack by Magma, a mutant assassin sent by Apocalypse, this attack provokes the anger of Brian Braddock that established a massive radioactive bombardment on North America as the final attack to the vicious reign of Apocalypse.
